# Medical Companions

> Animated, cited study and patient-education guides, one disease each. Researched and written with AI from published sources (every source checked against PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, ClinicalTrials.gov or the drug label), edited by a named person, and not yet clinically reviewed. Educational only, not medical advice.

- [About: who is responsible and how the guides are made](https://www.medcompanions.org/about/)
- [Privacy](https://www.medcompanions.org/privacy/)
